metadata_manifest_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) plus LF; structured_field_manifests resolve retained summary fields through this table.

numerical.method: Separate stdlib arithmetic reconstructs graded qrels from cached exact pinned archives or reads immutable bundled Git labels, verifies every exact query reference, and recomputes Hit/Recall/nDCG/MRR/session and linear-percentile latency without importing competitor, Mesh or scorer modules.

invalid_historical_mesh_harness_observat.cause: The comparator supplied index_timeout=120, outside Mesh's accepted 0..60 range; its blanket ValueError handler incorrectly counted configuration failure as content rejection.
invalid_historical_mesh_harness_observat.disposition: Their Mesh quality and latency are invalid and excluded from these numerical exports. Original artifacts remain unchanged.
invalid_historical_mesh_harness_observat.repaired_behavior: Supported timeout=60 is validated before ingestion; only actual content/guard rejections count as rejected parents, and other errors fail unscored.

limitations: Single serial query pass per independent hosted cell; no repeatability, general superiority or generated-answer accuracy claim.
Previously inspected direct-fact, long-text and six-query LongMemEval fixtures are bounded regressions, not independent held-out or full-population evaluations.
All submitted parents remain in original relevance denominators; unfaithful returned slots retain rank and receive no relevance credit.
Auxly's first ten distinct native matches form an unordered returned subset; ranked Hit/MRR/nDCG are unavailable.
SDK and MCP latencies are separate interface strata; ingestion contracts and dependency environments also differ.
Linux Python 3.12.16 native observations consume Windows Python 3.14/3.10 qualification snapshots; shared version equality is not identical platform or wheel-byte qualification.
Sampled tree RSS can double-count shared pages and miss peaks; sampled CPU can miss exited children.
Mesh uses overlapping window pooling; Mem0 truncates identical MiniLM assets at 256 tokens. Basic Memory and Auxly have no embeddings in these profiles.
